blockchain.title: Bitget hacker moves $83 million in stolen XRP that Ripple cannot freeze
blockchain.excerpt: Two wallets have been almost emptied and a third is being drained, with about $75 million remaining across the five original holding accounts.

blockchain.title: Bitcoin could soon get Zcash-style 'shielded' privacy without changing its rules
blockchain.excerpt: Researchers have mapped out private bitcoin-denominated transfers that run alongside Bitcoin, but the system still lacks a finished way to lock up real BTC and release it again.

blockchain.title: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce to leave post on Oct. 2
blockchain.excerpt: Peirce, known as “Crypto Mom,” served on the SEC for about eight years, including as director of the Crypto Task Force.

blockchain.title: Solana’s 150-millisecond settlement upgrade reaches second public test network
blockchain.excerpt: Alpenglow is running on both public test networks, giving application teams a place to check their software before the live blockchain switches.

blockchain.title: XRP Ledger’s Batch upgrade slips to Oct. 9 after validator support resets
blockchain.excerpt: The feature would let users bundle up to eight transactions, including asset-and-payment transfers, but a brief drop below the network’s 80% support threshold restarted its two-week activation clock.

defi.excerpt: The five-year deal could strengthen USDC’s reach in emerging markets, though Tether’s liquidity advantage remains hard to dislodge, analysts told CoinDesk.

defi.title: Another appeals court rules against prediction market provider Kalshi, says sports contracts are subject to state regulations
defi.excerpt: A Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals panel ruled that prediction markets' sports-related events contracts are not swaps, and therefore aren't subject to federal regulatory oversight.

defi.title: Circle and Tether Freeze Stablecoins Tied to Bitget Hack—But Most Funds Slip Away
defi.excerpt: The two stablecoin issuers blacklisted a wallet labeled "Bitget Exploiter 8," locking about $318,000 in USDC and USDT—but the attacker swapped most funds into unfreezable ETH before they could act.

defi.title: Crypto Biz: Wall Street and crypto fight for the same turf
defi.excerpt: Stablecoins and tokenized assets are pushing banks, exchanges and crypto companies into the same markets, from payments to stocks and ETFs.
